claims.text: ADR-0017 (document-reviewer + 4-cycle cap) is Accepted and confirmed; the 4-cycle reconciliation cap is canonical at ADR-0017 Decision section line 155 and is a PRD FR-3-c invariant.
ADR-0019 (naming convention) is Accepted and confirmed; phase-prefix 'execute-' for execution-phase agents and 'recipe-' for the orchestrator skill constrains any new sub-agent introduced under §6.

ADR-0022 (sub-agent reasoning configuration) is Accepted and confirmed; it covers the intentional model:/effort:/skills: triplet audited under SA-13 but does NOT cover the tools: field's runtime behavior (that's T-001's scope).
ADR-0027 (deliverable-archive gap) is Accepted and confirmed; the cwd-MUST-equal-repo-root precondition applies to the execution phase implicitly.
ADR-0029 (no silent scope changes) is Accepted and confirmed; the kill-criterion-#1 pause-and-rescope (PRD FR-2) IS the application of this principle.

ADR-0033 (ADR-0029 execution-phase extension) is Accepted and confirmed; line 51 names execute-orchestrator plus the 4 specialists explicitly, and line 71 specifies symmetric D-12: 'cycle-cap exhaustion (per ADR-0017 4-cycle cap, symmetric per D-12) IS a deviation'.
ADR-0036 (single-location ADR placement) is Accepted and confirmed; any ADR design-composer authors lands at adrs/ADR-NNNN-<title>.md only.

ADR-0037 (mcp-events.jsonl transition surfacing) is Accepted; its applicability to this feature is conditional, constraining only if a §6 option introduces a new MCP-dispatch mechanism (likely N/A for options (a)/(b)).
ADR-0040 (Serena narrowed always-on) is Accepted; none of the execute-* agents are in the Serena allowlist, making it an unlikely constraint.
ADR-0041 (install-mechanism hybrid) is Accepted; install-path discipline is unlikely to constrain unless option (c) introduces a new script.

ADR-0035 (auditing-shared skill-binding convention) is newly-surfaced and not in the Research Plan's inherited-ADR list; it is referenced in execute-finalize-reconciler.md body line 110 as 'The auditing-shared binding is the new convention per ADR-0035 (cycle 3 of this design feature run).'
